versions.changelog:
Initial release of architect-diagram-pro:

- Local-first tool for generating architecture, flowcharts, sequence, ER, Gantt, and network diagrams.
- No cloud, Node.js, or API key required; all processing and rendering is fully local.
- Supports both self-contained HTML and inline SVG outputs.
- Enforces layout, spacing, text safety, and error-handling rules for all diagrams.
- Includes built-in guardrails, semantic planning, and multi-step workflow for quality and correctness.
- Covers most architecture/diagram types with clear boundaries and user confirmation for unsupported cases.
